supportedRuntimes.orchestration: Docker Engine with Docker Compose v2

testedPlatforms.coverage: Required automated gate: complete disposable-stack acceptance against exact published candidate digests.
Required automated gate: image build, architecture, source identity and license inventory validation.
Required before stable promotion: exact-candidate runtime acceptance and stable0.4-to0.5 upgrade, backup restoration and rollback rehearsal. Reviewed release acceptance summary records results.

knownLimitations: Battery history is a BMS rated-range estimate relative to the first month with usable range observations, not a battery-health test or a comparison with a new battery.
Battery range history requires TeslaMate post-charge rated-range data; imports without these measurements remain unavailable.
Charging efficiency and costs depend on paired energy observations and known prices; currencies are never converted or inferred.
TeslaMate4.0.2 through4.1.x are bounded by the tested4.0.1 and4.2.0 endpoints rather than dedicated fixtures for every intermediate release.
One vehicle per installation is the supported focus; an existing supported TeslaMate database is required.
